params.command:
SELECT 1 AS ok,
       current_database()                       AS database,
       current_user                             AS connected_as,
       pg_is_in_recovery()                      AS in_recovery,
       pg_postmaster_start_time()               AS started_at,
       date_trunc('second', now() - pg_postmaster_start_time()) AS uptime,
       substring(version() from 'PostgreSQL [0-9.]+') AS server_version,
       pg_has_role(current_user, 'pg_monitor', 'member') AS has_pg_monitor

SELECT (SELECT setting::int FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections') AS max_connections,
       count(*)                                                        AS total_connections,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'active')                        AS active,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle')                          AS idle,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'idle in transaction')           AS idle_in_transaction,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock')                AS waiting_on_lock,
       round(100.0 * count(*)
             / (SELECT setting::numeric FROM pg_settings WHERE name = 'max_connections'), 1)
                                                                       AS pct_of_max
FROM pg_stat_activity

SELECT pid,
       usename                                   AS username,
       application_name,
       client_addr,
       state,
       wait_event_type,
       wait_event,
       date_trunc('second', now() - xact_start)  AS transaction_age,
       date_trunc('second', now() - query_start) AS query_age,
       cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid))        AS blocker_count,
       pg_blocking_pids(pid)                     AS blocked_by,
       left(regexp_replace(query, '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 200) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid()
  AND state <> 'idle'
  AND (now() - query_start > interval '30 seconds'
       OR cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > 0)
ORDER BY blocker_count DESC, query_age DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

SELECT pg_is_in_recovery() AS is_replica,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_replication)                    AS connected_standbys,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_replication_slots WHERE NOT active)  AS inactive_slots,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM write_lag)::numeric, 2)), 0)
          FROM pg_stat_replication)                                  AS max_write_lag_s,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM replay_lag)::numeric, 2)), 0)
          FROM pg_stat_replication)                                  AS max_replay_lag_s,
       CASE WHEN pg_is_in_recovery()
            THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()))::numeric, 2)
       END                                                           AS replica_lag_s

SELECT current_setting('data_directory')                      AS data_directory,
       pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))    AS database_size,
       pg_database_size(current_database())                    AS database_size_bytes,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_ls_waldir())                   AS wal_file_count,
       (SELECT pg_size_pretty(coalesce(sum(size), 0)) FROM pg_ls_waldir()) AS wal_size,
       current_setting('max_wal_size')                         AS max_wal_size,
       (SELECT string_agg(t, ', ' ORDER BY t)
          FROM (SELECT quote_ident(n.nspname) || '.' || quote_ident(c.relname)
                       || ' (' || pg_size_pretty(c.relpages::bigint
                                * current_setting('block_size')::bigint)
                       || ', estimated)' AS t
                FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
                WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','m')
                  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
                ORDER BY c.relpages DESC
                LIMIT 5) s)                                    AS largest_tables

SELECT datname                                   AS database,
       xact_commit,
       xact_rollback,
       deadlocks,
       conflicts,
       temp_files,
       pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes)                AS temp_bytes,
       blks_read,
       blks_hit,
       round(100.0 * blks_hit / nullif(blks_hit + blks_read, 0), 2) AS cache_hit_pct,
       round(100.0 * xact_rollback / nullif(xact_commit + xact_rollback, 0), 2) AS rollback_pct,
       stats_reset
FROM pg_stat_database
WHERE datname = current_database()
